svg.title: The full-family identities (TF17)–(TF19) require absolute summation before truncation. We give the construction that transports these identities across a block. For a two-curvature atom a, let qa be its coefficient with its plaquette and color types fixed, and let δa ∈Z4 be the displacement from its first leg to its second. Its length bounds |δa|. A charged exponential bound implies X a |qa| < ∞, X a |qaδi a| < ∞, (LM1)
